chapter: Money, radio and Sam Morgan's band
title: Sam Morgan's band on radio and the Gulf Coast circuit
summary: The Morgan band played soft swing music, double rushes and radio spots, and toured Gulfport, Biloxi, Mobile and Meridian.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
